raw:
Sergio Pérez drove for Racing Point throughout 2019, and his teammate for the full season was Lance Stroll. Race results show both drivers at Racing Point in the 2019 Japanese, Belgian, and Mexican Grands Prix, and the 2019 final standings list both of them under Racing Point (Pérez 10th with 52 points, Stroll 15th with 21). I did not find a race-by-race check of every round, so this rests on the season-level record.

ANSWER: Lance Stroll
